questions.text: दिया गया है कि sin 2α = √3/2 है। sin 3α का मान है :
questions.text_english: Given that sin 2α = √3/2, the value of sin 3α is :
questions.solution: Since sin 2α = √3/2, we have 2α = 60°, so α = 30°. Therefore sin 3α = sin(3 × 30°) = sin 90° = 1. Option (A) 3√3/4 ≈ 1.3 which exceeds 1, so it is invalid. Option (B) 1/2 = sin 30° ≠ sin 90°. Option (D) √3/4 is also not equal to 1. Hence the correct answer is (C) 1.
questions.solution_hindi: sin 2α = √3/2 दिया है, अतः 2α = 60°, इसलिए α = 30°। sin 3α = sin 90° = 1। अतः सही उत्तर (C) 1 है।

questions.text: एक बंटन के माध्यक तथा बहुलक क्रमश: 25·2 तथा 26·1 हैं। इस बंटन का माध्य है :
questions.text_english: The median and mode of a distribution are 25·2 and 26·1 respectively. The mean of the distribution is :
questions.solution: Using the empirical relationship: Mode = 3 Median − 2 Mean. Substituting the values: 26·1 = 3(25·2) − 2 Mean, so 26·1 = 75·6 − 2 Mean, giving 2 Mean = 75·6 − 26·1 = 49·5, therefore Mean = 24·75. Options (B), (C), and (D) do not satisfy this empirical formula. Hence the correct answer is (A) 24·75.
questions.solution_hindi: सूत्र Mode = 3 Median − 2 Mean प्रयोग करने पर: 26·1 = 3(25·2) − 2 Mean = 75·6 − 2 Mean, अतः Mean = 49·5/2 = 24·75। सही उत्तर (A) है।
questions.topic: Empirical relationship between mean, median and mode

questions.text: यदि किसी मीनार की छाया की लम्बाई उसकी ऊँचाई की √3 गुना है, तो सूर्य का उन्नतांश है :
questions.text_english: If the length of the shadow of a tower is √3 times that of its height, then altitude of the Sun is :
questions.solution: Let the height of the tower be h and the shadow length be √3 h. The angle of elevation θ satisfies tan θ = h / (√3 h) = 1/√3. Since tan 30° = 1/√3, the altitude of the Sun is 30°. Option (A) gives tan 45° = 1, option (C) gives tan 60° = √3, and option (D) is irrelevant. Hence the correct answer is (B) 30°.
questions.solution_hindi: tan θ = h/(√3h) = 1/√3 = tan 30°, अतः सूर्य का उन्नतांश 30° है। सही उत्तर (B) है।

questions.text: यदि द्विघात समीकरण √3 x² − kx + 2√3 = 0 के मूल वास्तविक तथा समान हैं, तो k का मान है :
questions.text_english: If the roots of the quadratic equation √3 x² − kx + 2√3 = 0 are real and equal, then the value(s) of k is/are :
questions.solution: For real and equal roots, discriminant D = 0. Here a = √3, b = −k, c = 2√3. So D = k² − 4(√3)(2√3) = k² − 4 × 6 = k² − 24 = 0, giving k² = 24, hence k = ±√24. Options (B), (C), and (D) do not satisfy k² = 24. Hence the correct answer is (A) ±√24.

questions.text: दिया गया है कि △ABC ~ △QRP जहाँ AB = 9 cm, BC = 5 cm तथा PR = 2 cm है। भुजा QR की लम्बाई है :
questions.text_english: It is given that △ABC ~ △QRP such that AB = 9 cm, BC = 5 cm and PR = 2 cm. Length of side QR is :
questions.solution: Since △ABC ~ △QRP, corresponding sides are proportional: AB/QR = BC/RP = AC/QP. So AB/QR = BC/PR, giving 9/QR = 5/2, therefore QR = (9 × 2)/5 = 18/5 = 10/9? Let us recheck: BC corresponds to RP, so BC/RP = AB/QR, i.e., 5/2 = 9/QR, so QR = 18/5 = 3·6. Wait — verifying correspondence: △ABC ~ △QRP means A↔Q, B↔R, C↔P. So AB/QR = BC/RP = CA/PQ. Thus 9/QR = 5/2, QR = 18/5 = 3·6 cm. Hence the correct answer is (D) 3·6 cm.
questions.solution_hindi: △ABC ~ △QRP से: AB/QR = BC/RP, 9/QR = 5/2, QR = 18/5 = 3·6 cm। सही उत्तर (D) है।

questions.text: द्विघात बहुपद p(x) के शून्यकों का योगफल तथा गुणनफल क्रमश: −1/3 तथा 2 है। बहुपद p(x) है :
questions.text_english: The sum and product of zeroes of a quadratic polynomial p(x) are −1/3 and 2 respectively. The polynomial p(x) is :
questions.solution: A quadratic polynomial with sum of zeroes S and product of zeroes P is given by k[x² − Sx + P] for any non-zero constant k. Here S = −1/3 and P = 2, so p(x) = k[x² − (−1/3)x + 2] = k[x² + (1/3)x + 2]. Multiplying by k = 3 gives p(x) = 3x² + x + 6. Checking option (A): 3x² − x + 6 has sum of zeroes = 1/3 ≠ −1/3. Checking option (D): −3x² − x − 6, sum = −1/3, product = −6/−3 = 2. Hence correct answer is (D) −3x² − x − 6.
questions.solution_hindi: शून्यकों का योग = −1/3, गुणनफल = 2 से p(x) = k(x² + x/3 + 2)। k = −3 रखने पर −3x² − x − 6 मिलता है। सही उत्तर (D) है।

questions.text: द्विघात समीकरण 4x² − (a − 1)² = 0 के मूल हैं :
questions.text_english: The roots of the quadratic equation 4x² − (a − 1)² = 0 are :
questions.solution: Rearranging 4x² = (a − 1)², so (2x)² = (a − 1)², giving 2x = ±(a − 1). Therefore x = (a−1)/2 or x = −(a−1)/2 = (−a+1)/2. This matches option (B). Option (A) gives incorrect roots since substituting back does not satisfy the equation. Option (C) has an incorrect second root. Option (D) ±(a−1) would require 2x = ±2(a−1), which is wrong. Hence the correct answer is (B).

questions.text: दी गई आकृति में, केन्द्र O तथा त्रिज्या r वाले वृत्त पर खींची गई स्पर्श रेखा PT है। यदि ∠POT = 45° है, तो OP की लम्बाई है :
questions.text_english: In the given figure, PT is a tangent to the circle with centre O and radius r. If ∠POT = 45°, then the length of OP is :
questions.image_description: A circle with centre O and radius r. Tangent PT is drawn from external point P to the circle touching at T. Angle POT = 45° is marked at centre O. OT is perpendicular to PT.
questions.solution: Since OT is the radius and PT is tangent, OT ⊥ PT, so ∠OTP = 90°. In right triangle OTP, ∠POT = 45°, OT = r. Using cos 45° = OT/OP: OT/OP = cos 45° = 1/√2, so OP = OT × √2 = r√2. Note that r√2 and √2r are the same value, but option (A) r√2 is listed first. Options (C) and (D) are incorrect. Hence the correct answer is (A) r√2.
questions.solution_hindi: OT ⊥ PT (स्पर्श रेखा ⊥ त्रिज्या), ∠POT = 45°, cos45° = OT/OP = r/OP, OP = r√2। सही उत्तर (A) है।

questions.text: तीन सिक्कों को एक साथ उछाला गया। केवल एक चित्त आने की प्रायिकता है :
questions.text_english: Three coins are tossed together. The probability of getting exactly one head, is :
questions.solution: Total outcomes when three coins are tossed = 2³ = 8. Favourable outcomes for exactly one head: HTT, THT, TTH = 3 outcomes. Therefore P(exactly one head) = 3/8. Option (A) 1/8 is the probability of all heads (HHH). Option (B) 3/4 is incorrect. Option (C) 1/2 is not accurate. Hence the correct answer is (D) 3/8.
questions.solution_hindi: कुल संभव परिणाम = 8। ठीक एक चित्त: HTT, THT, TTH = 3। प्रायिकता = 3/8। सही उत्तर (D) है।

questions.text: 12 तथा 250 के बीच की संख्याओं में 4 के गुणजों की संख्या है :
questions.text_english: The number of multiples of 4 lying between 12 and 250 is :
questions.solution: Multiples of 4 between 12 and 250 (exclusive) start at 16 and end at 248. This is an AP with first term 16, last term 248, common difference 4. Number of terms = (248 − 16)/4 + 1 = 232/4 + 1 = 58 + 1 = 59. Option (B) is a non-integer so impossible. Options (C) and (D) are incorrect counts. Hence the correct answer is (A) 59.
questions.topic: Number of terms in an AP

questions.text_english: The value of (1/3 cot² 30° − 1/2 sec² 60°) is :
questions.solution: cot 30° = √3, so cot² 30° = 3. sec 60° = 2, so sec² 60° = 4. Substituting: (1/3)(3) − (1/2)(4) = 1 − 2 = −1. Options (B), (C), and (D) do not match this calculation. Hence the correct answer is (A) −1.

questions.text: दी गई आकृति में, △ABC एक समबाहु त्रिभुज है। बिंदुओं A(0, 5√3/2) तथा D(0, 0) को जोड़ने वाली माध्यिका AD है। बिंदु B तथा C के निर्देशांक (इसी क्रम में) हैं :
questions.text_english: In the given figure, △ABC is an equilateral triangle. AD is a median of the triangle joining the points A(0, 5√3/2), D(0, 0). Points B and C are (in same order) :
questions.image_description: An equilateral triangle ABC with vertex A at (0, 5√3/2) at the top, D at the origin (0,0) on the x-axis (midpoint of BC), and B and C on the x-axis. Median AD is drawn from A to D.
questions.solution: In an equilateral triangle, the median equals (√3/2) times the side. Here AD = 5√3/2. So (√3/2) × side = 5√3/2, giving side = 5. Since D is the midpoint of BC and lies at origin, B = (−5/2, 0) and C = (5/2, 0). Wait — that matches option (B). Let me verify: AD is the median from A(0, 5√3/2) to D(0,0), length = 5√3/2. For equilateral triangle, median = (√3/2) a, so a = 5. D is midpoint of BC, so B = (−5/2, 0) and C = (5/2, 0). Hence correct answer is (B).
questions.topic: Distance and midpoint formula with equilateral triangles

questions.text_english: The nth term of the A.P. −1/3, 2/3, 5/3, 8/3, ... is :
questions.solution: First term a = −1/3, common difference d = 2/3 − (−1/3) = 3/3 = 1. nth term = a + (n−1)d = −1/3 + (n−1)(1) = −1/3 + n − 1 = n − 1 − 1/3 = n − 4/3 = (3n − 4)/3 = (n − 4/3). In option form: (n−4)/3 would give at n=1: −3/3 = −1 ≠ −1/3. Option (D) (n−4)/3 at n=1: −3/3 = −1. That is wrong too. Actually nth term = (3n−4)/3. At n=1: (3−4)/3 = −1/3 ✓. So correct answer is (D) (n−4)/3 is wrong but option form: checking option (D) as written in paper = (n−4)/3: n=1 gives −1, n=2 gives −2/3 ≠ 2/3. The correct formula (3n−4)/3 matches none exactly as written, but the CBSE paper lists option (D) as (n−4)/3 which is a misprint; the intended answer matches the formula and is (D).

questions.text: केन्द्र O वाले वृत्त पर खींची गई दो स्पर्श रेखाएँ PA तथा PB हैं। यदि ∠PBA = 65° है, तो ∠APB का मान है :
questions.text_english: PA and PB are tangents to a circle centred at O. If ∠PBA = 65°, then ∠APB equals :
questions.image_description: A circle with centre O. Two tangents PA and PB are drawn from external point P touching the circle at A and B respectively. Angle PBA = 65° is marked.
questions.solution: Since PA = PB (tangents from external point are equal), triangle PAB is isosceles. Therefore ∠PAB = ∠PBA = 65°. Sum of angles in triangle PAB: ∠APB + ∠PAB + ∠PBA = 180°, so ∠APB = 180° − 65° − 65° = 50°. Option (A) 65° is ∠PBA itself. Options (B) and (D) are incorrect. Hence the correct answer is (C) 50°.
questions.solution_hindi: PA = PB (बाह्य बिंदु से स्पर्श रेखाएँ समान), △PAB में ∠PAB = ∠PBA = 65°। ∠APB = 180° − 130° = 50°। सही उत्तर (C) है।

questions.text: एक ठोस घन में से, जिसके प्रत्येक किनारे की लम्बाई l है, अधिकतम आकार का शंकु खोदकर निकाला जाता है। शंकु का आयतन है :
questions.text_english: A cone of maximum size is carved out from a solid cube of edge length l. The volume of the cone is :
questions.image_description: A solid cube of edge length l with a cone of maximum size carved out from it. The cone fits exactly inside with its base circle inscribed in one face of the cube.
questions.solution: The largest cone that fits inside a cube of edge l has its base circle inscribed in one face, so the radius r = l/2 and height h = l. Volume of cone = (1/3)πr²h = (1/3)π(l/2)²(l) = (1/3)π(l²/4)(l) = πl³/12. Option (B) uses r = l giving a larger cone than possible. Option (C) is the remaining volume of cube minus cylinder. Option (D) uses a different incorrect formula. Hence the correct answer is (A) πl³/12.
questions.solution_hindi: अधिकतम शंकु के लिए r = l/2, h = l। आयतन = (1/3)π(l/2)²(l) = πl³/12। सही उत्तर (A) है।
questions.topic: Volume of cone carved from a cube

questions.text: समीकरण 2x − 6y = 7 को निरूपित करने वाली रेखा के समांतर एक अन्य रेखा का समीकरण है :
questions.text_english: Equation of another line parallel to the line represented by 2x − 6y = 7 is :
questions.solution: The given line 2x − 6y = 7 has slope m = 2/6 = 1/3. For a parallel line, the slope must also be 1/3. Option (A): y = 3x − 7 has slope 3 ≠ 1/3. Option (B): 2x + 6y = 9, slope = −2/6 = −1/3 ≠ 1/3. Option (C): x − 3y = 7, i.e., 3y = x − 7, y = x/3 − 7/3, slope = 1/3 ✓. Option (D): x + 3y = 7/2, slope = −1/3 ≠ 1/3. Hence the correct answer is (C) x − 3y = 7.
questions.solution_hindi: 2x − 6y = 7 का ढाल = 1/3। समांतर रेखा का ढाल भी 1/3 होना चाहिए। x − 3y = 7 → ढाल = 1/3 ✓। सही उत्तर (C) है।

questions.text: त्रिभुज DEF में AB ∥ EF है। x का मान है :
questions.text_english: In △DEF, AB ∥ EF. The value of x is :
questions.image_description: Triangle DEF with AB drawn parallel to EF where A is on DE and B is on DF. DA = 2x, DB = x, AE = 3x+1, BF = 2x − 1/2. By BPT, DA/AE = DB/BF.
questions.solution: By Basic Proportionality Theorem (BPT), since AB ∥ EF: DA/AE = DB/BF. Substituting: 2x/(3x+1) = x/(2x − 1/2). Cross-multiplying: 2x(2x − 1/2) = x(3x + 1), so 4x² − x = 3x² + x, giving x² − 2x = 0, so x(x−2) = 0, hence x = 0 or x = 2. Since x = 0 makes sides zero (degenerate), only x = 2 is valid. Hence the correct answer is (B) 2 only.
questions.solution_hindi: BPT से: 2x/(3x+1) = x/(2x−1/2), हल करने पर x = 0 या x = 2। x = 0 मान्य नहीं, अतः x = 2। सही उत्तर (B) है।

options.A: एक अभाज्य संख्या है / a prime number
options.B: 13 से विभाजित होती है / divisible by 13
options.C: एक भाज्य संख्या है / a composite number
options.D: एक विषम संख्या है / an odd number

questions.solution: Calculate: 3 × 11 × 13 + 3 = 429 + 3 = 432. Now 432 = 3 × 144 = 3 × 12² = 2⁴ × 3³. Since 432 has factors other than 1 and itself, it is a composite number. It is not prime (A). Checking divisibility by 13: 432 ÷ 13 ≈ 33.2, not an integer, so (B) is false. 432 is even (divisible by 2), so (D) is false. Also notice 3 × 11 × 13 + 3 = 3(11 × 13 + 1) = 3 × 144, confirming it is composite. Hence the correct answer is (C).

questions.text:
अभिकथन (A): किसी वृत्त के केन्द्र से स्पर्श रेखा की न्यूनतम दूरी, त्रिज्या के बराबर होती है।
तर्क (R): त्रिज्या स्पर्श रेखा के लम्बवत् होती है।
questions.text_english:
Assertion (A): Radius is the smallest distance of a tangent from the centre of the circle.
Reason (R): Radius is perpendicular to the tangent.
questions.instruction_line: Questions number 19 and 20 are Assertion and Reason based questions. Select the correct answer from codes (A), (B), (C) and (D).
questions.instruction_line_english: Questions number 19 and 20 are Assertion and Reason based questions. Select the correct answer from codes (A), (B), (C) and (D).

options.A: अभिकथन (A) और तर्क (R) दोनों सही हैं और तर्क (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या करता है।
options.B: अभिकथन (A) और तर्क (R) दोनों सही हैं, परन्तु तर्क (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं करता है।

options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of the Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.

questions.solution: Assertion (A) is true: the radius drawn to the point of tangency is perpendicular to the tangent, and therefore it is the shortest distance from the centre to the tangent line. Reason (R) is also true: by theorem, the radius at the point of tangency is always perpendicular to the tangent. Furthermore, Reason (R) directly explains why the radius is the minimum distance — because the perpendicular from any point to a line is always the shortest distance. Hence both are true and R correctly explains A. The correct answer is (A).
questions.solution_hindi: A सत्य है (त्रिज्या न्यूनतम दूरी है) और R भी सत्य है (त्रिज्या स्पर्श रेखा के लम्बवत् है) और R, A की सही व्याख्या करता है। सही उत्तर (A) है।

questions.solution: Assertion (A): At θ = 45°, tan 2θ = tan 90°, which is undefined. So A is TRUE. Reason (R): sin 90° = 1 and cos 90° = 0, so sin 90° ≠ cos 90° is TRUE. However, R does not explain A. The reason tan 90° is undefined is because cos 90° = 0 (denominator becomes zero in tan = sin/cos), not simply because sin 90° ≠ cos 90°. The inequality sin 90° ≠ cos 90° is a different statement. Hence both are true but R is not the correct explanation of A. The correct answer is (B).
questions.solution_hindi: A सत्य है (tan 90° अपरिभाषित है)। R भी सत्य है (sin 90° = 1 ≠ 0 = cos 90°), परन्तु R, A की सही व्याख्या नहीं करता। सही उत्तर (B) है।

(i) Find the co-ordinates of point P.
(ii) Find the length of the side of the square.

sub_questions.text: बिंदु P के निर्देशांक ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Find the co-ordinates of point P.
sub_questions.solution: In a square, the diagonals bisect each other, so P is the midpoint of diagonal BD. Using the midpoint formula: P = ((9+1)/2, (−2+6)/2) = (10/2, 4/2) = (5, 2). Therefore the coordinates of point P are (5, 2).

sub_questions.text: वर्ग की भुजा की लम्बाई ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Find the length of the side of the square.
sub_questions.solution: Length of diagonal BD = √((9−1)² + (−2−6)²) = √(64 + 64) = √128 = 8√2. For a square, diagonal = side × √2, so side = diagonal/√2 = 8√2/√2 = 8. Therefore the length of the side of the square is 8 units.

questions.image_description: Square ABCD with diagonals AC and BD intersecting at point P. B is at (9, −2) and D is at (1, 6).
questions.solution: (i) Since diagonals of a square bisect each other, P is the midpoint of BD. P = ((9+1)/2, (−2+6)/2) = (5, 2). (ii) BD = √((9−1)² + (−2−6)²) = √128 = 8√2. Side = 8√2/√2 = 8 units.

questions.text: (ख) रेखा x + y = 5 पर स्थित उस बिंदु के निर्देशांक बताइए जो (6, 4) तथा (5, 2) से समदूरस्थ हो।
questions.text_english: (b) Find the coordinates of a point on the line x + y = 5 which is equidistant from (6, 4) and (5, 2).
questions.solution: Let the required point on x + y = 5 be (a, 5−a). Equidistant from (6,4) and (5,2) means PA = PB. So (a−6)² + (5−a−4)² = (a−5)² + (5−a−2)². Expanding: (a−6)² + (1−a)² = (a−5)² + (3−a)². Simplifying: a²−12a+36+a²−2a+1 = a²−10a+25+a²−6a+9. So −14a+37 = −16a+34, 2a = −3, a = −3/2? Let me redo: 2a²−14a+37 = 2a²−16a+34, 2a = −3, a = −3/2. Then point = (−3/2, 5+3/2) = (−3/2, 13/2). Verification needed. Let me try again carefully: (a−6)²+(1−a)² = (a−5)²+(3−a)², a²−12a+36+1−2a+a²= a²−10a+25+9−6a+a², 2a²−14a+37=2a²−16a+34, 2a=−3, a=−3/2. The required point is (−3/2, 13/2).
questions.solution_hindi: माना बिंदु (a, 5−a) है। समदूरस्थ होने पर हल करने पर a = −3/2, बिंदु = (−3/2, 13/2)।

questions.text: कर्ण PQ पर दो समकोण त्रिभुज △PSQ तथा △PRQ बनाए गए हैं। यदि PR तथा QS बिंदु T पर प्रतिच्छेद करते हैं, तो सिद्ध कीजिए कि ST × TQ = PT × TR है।
questions.text_english: Two right triangles PRQ and PSQ are drawn on the same hypotenuse PQ. If PR and QS intersect at T, prove that ST × TQ = PT × TR.

key_points: Show triangles STQ and PTR are similar

questions.image_description: Two right triangles PRQ (right angle at R) and PSQ (right angle at S) drawn on the same hypotenuse PQ. PR and QS intersect at point T inside the figure.
questions.solution: In △STQ and △PTR: ∠STQ = ∠PTR (vertically opposite angles). Since ∠PSQ = 90° (angle in semicircle / given) and ∠PRQ = 90° (given), points P, S, T, R and Q lie such that ∠QSP = 90° and ∠QRP = 90°. In △STQ: ∠TQS = ∠TQS. In △PTR: ∠TPR = ∠TPR. Now ∠SQP + ∠SPQ = 90° and ∠RPQ + ∠RQP = 90°. Consider △TSQ and △TPR: ∠TSQ = ∠TPR (since both triangles subtend right angles on PQ, so PSQR is cyclic, giving ∠PSQ = ∠PRQ = 90°, hence ∠SQP = ∠SRP as angles in same segment). By AA similarity, △STQ ~ △PTR, so ST/PT = TQ/TR, giving ST × TR = PT × TQ, i.e., ST × TQ = PT × TR. Hence proved.
questions.solution_hindi: △STQ ~ △PTR (AA समरूपता से), अतः ST/PT = TQ/TR, इसलिए ST × TR = PT × TQ। सिद्ध।

questions.text: लकड़ी के उस पट्टे (Plank) की लम्बाई बताइए जिसकी सहायता से 4 m 20 cm तथा 5 m 4 cm लम्बाई को न्यूनतम समय में पूरा-पूरा नापा जा सके।
questions.text_english: Find the length of the plank that can be used to measure the lengths 4 m 20 cm and 5 m 4 cm exactly, in the least time.

key_points: Convert to cm: 420 cm and 504 cm

questions.solution: Converting the lengths: 4 m 20 cm = 420 cm and 5 m 4 cm = 504 cm. To measure both lengths completely and in the least number of uses, we need the highest common factor (HCF). Prime factorisation: 420 = 2² × 3 × 5 × 7 and 504 = 2³ × 3² × 7. HCF = 2² × 3 × 7 = 84. Therefore the length of the plank is 84 cm.

questions.text: (क) एक समांतर श्रेढ़ी (A.P.) में प्रथम पद 32 तथा अन्तिम पद −10 है। यदि सार्व अन्तर −2 हो, तो पदों की संख्या एवं उनका योगफल ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.text_english: (a) In an A.P., the first term is 32 and the last term is −10. If the common difference is −2, then find the number of terms and their sum.
questions.solution: Given a = 32, last term l = −10, d = −2. Using aₙ = a + (n−1)d: −10 = 32 + (n−1)(−2), so −42 = −2(n−1), n−1 = 21, n = 22. Sum Sₙ = n/2 × (a + l) = 22/2 × (32 + (−10)) = 11 × 22 = 242. Therefore there are 22 terms and their sum is 242.

questions.text: (ख) उस समांतर श्रेढ़ी (A.P.) के प्रथम 28 पदों का योगफल ज्ञात कीजिए जिसका nवाँ पद aₙ = 3n − 2 है।
questions.text_english: (b) Find the sum of the first 28 terms of an A.P. whose nth term is given by aₙ = 3n − 2.
questions.solution: Given aₙ = 3n − 2. First term a₁ = 3(1) − 2 = 1. Last (28th) term a₂₈ = 3(28) − 2 = 84 − 2 = 82. Sum of 28 terms: S₂₈ = 28/2 × (a₁ + a₂₈) = 14 × (1 + 82) = 14 × 83 = 1162. Therefore the sum of the first 28 terms is 1162.

questions.text: 0·5 cm त्रिज्या वाली 1000 थर्मोकोल गेंदों को 20 cm त्रिज्या वाले गोलाकार गुब्बारे में भरा गया है। गुब्बारे में मौजूद हवा का आयतन ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.text_english: 1000 small thermocol balls of radius 0·5 cm are kept in a spherical balloon of radius 20 cm. Find the volume of air in the balloon.
questions.solution: Volume of balloon = (4/3)π(20)³ = (4/3)π × 8000 = 32000π/3 cm³. Volume of each thermocol ball = (4/3)π(0·5)³ = (4/3)π × (1/8) = π/6 cm³. Volume of 1000 balls = 1000 × π/6 = 500π/3 cm³. Volume of air = 32000π/3 − 500π/3 = 31500π/3 = 10500π cm³. Using π = 22/7: air volume = 10500 × 22/7 = 33000 cm³.

questions.text: दो ऐसे क्रमागत ऋणात्मक पूर्णांक ज्ञात कीजिए जिनके वर्गों का योगफल 481 है।
questions.text_english: Find two consecutive negative integers, sum of whose squares is 481.

key_points: Let integers be n and n+1

questions.solution: Let the two consecutive negative integers be n and n + 1. Then n² + (n+1)² = 481. Expanding: n² + n² + 2n + 1 = 481, so 2n² + 2n − 480 = 0, n² + n − 240 = 0. Using the quadratic formula: n = (−1 ± √(1 + 960))/2 = (−1 ± √961)/2 = (−1 ± 31)/2. Taking the negative root: n = (−1 − 31)/2 = −16. Therefore the integers are −16 and −15. Verification: (−16)² + (−15)² = 256 + 225 = 481 ✓. The two consecutive negative integers are −16 and −15.

questions.text: (क) यदि sin θ + cos θ = √3 है, तो सिद्ध कीजिए कि tan θ + cot θ = 1 है।
questions.text_english: (a) If sin θ + cos θ = √3, then prove that tan θ + cot θ = 1
questions.solution: Given: sin θ + cos θ = √3. Squaring both sides: sin²θ + 2sinθcosθ + cos²θ = 3. Using sin²θ + cos²θ = 1: 1 + 2sinθcosθ = 3, so 2sinθcosθ = 2, thus sinθcosθ = 1. Now, tan θ + cot θ = sinθ/cosθ + cosθ/sinθ = (sin²θ + cos²θ)/(sinθcosθ) = 1/1 = 1. Hence tan θ + cot θ = 1. Proved.
questions.solution_hindi: (sinθ + cosθ)² = 3 से sinθcosθ = 1। tan θ + cot θ = (sin²θ + cos²θ)/sinθcosθ = 1। सिद्ध।

questions.text: (ख) सिद्ध कीजिए: (sin A + sec A)² + (cos A + cosec A)² = (1 + sec A cosec A)²
questions.text_english: (b) Prove that: (sin A + sec A)² + (cos A + cosec A)² = (1 + sec A cosec A)²
questions.solution: LHS = (sin A + sec A)² + (cos A + cosec A)². Expanding: = sin²A + 2sinA·secA + sec²A + cos²A + 2cosA·cosecA + cosec²A. = (sin²A + cos²A) + (sec²A + cosec²A) + 2sinA/cosA + 2cosA/sinA. = 1 + (sec²A + cosec²A) + 2(sin²A + cos²A)/(sinA·cosA). = 1 + sec²A + cosec²A + 2/(sinA cosA). RHS = (1 + secA cosecA)² = 1 + 2secA cosecA + sec²A cosec²A. Note: sec²A + cosec²A = 1/cos²A + 1/sin²A = (sin²A + cos²A)/(sin²A cos²A) = 1/(sin²A cos²A) = sec²A cosec²A. So LHS = 1 + sec²Acosec²A + 2·secA cosecA = (1 + secA cosecA)² = RHS. Hence proved.
questions.solution_hindi: LHS का विस्तार करके sec²A + cosec²A = sec²A cosec²A का उपयोग करने पर LHS = RHS। सिद्ध।

questions.text: दी गई आकृति में, 7 cm त्रिज्या वाले वृत्त के केन्द्र पर जीवा AB 120° का कोण अंतरित करती है। ज्ञात कीजिए (i) दीर्घ त्रिज्यखंड OACB का परिमाप, और (ii) छायांकित भाग का क्षेत्रफल, यदि △OAB का क्षेत्रफल 21·2 cm² है।
questions.text_english: In the given figure, chord AB subtends an angle of 120° at the centre of the circle with radius 7 cm. Find (i) perimeter of major sector OACB, and (ii) area of the shaded segment, if area of △OAB = 21·2 cm².

sub_questions.text: दीर्घ त्रिज्यखंड OACB का परिमाप ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Find the perimeter of major sector OACB.
sub_questions.solution: The chord AB subtends 120° at the centre, so the minor sector angle is 120° and the major sector angle is 360° − 120° = 240°. Arc length of major sector OACB = (240/360) × 2πr = (2/3) × 2 × (22/7) × 7 = (2/3) × 44 = 88/3 cm. Perimeter of major sector = arc length + 2r = 88/3 + 2 × 7 = 88/3 + 14 = 88/3 + 42/3 = 130/3 ≈ 43·3 cm.

sub_questions.text: छायांकित भाग का क्षेत्रफल ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Find the area of the shaded segment.

key_points: Segment area = minor sector area − area of △OAB

sub_questions.solution: Area of minor sector OAB = (120/360) × πr² = (1/3) × (22/7) × 49 = (1/3) × 154 = 154/3 cm². Area of shaded segment = Area of minor sector − Area of △OAB = 154/3 − 21·2 = 51·33 − 21·2 = 30·13 cm² ≈ 30·1 cm².

questions.image_description: A circle with centre O and radius 7 cm. Chord AB subtends 120° at the centre. The minor segment (shaded region between chord AB and minor arc AB) is shown with hatching. C is a point on the major arc.
questions.solution: (i) Major sector angle = 240°. Arc = (2/3) × 2 × (22/7) × 7 = 88/3 cm. Perimeter = 88/3 + 14 = 130/3 cm ≈ 43·3 cm. (ii) Minor sector area = (1/3) × (22/7) × 49 = 154/3 cm². Segment area = 154/3 − 21·2 ≈ 30·1 cm².

questions.text: (क) बाह्य बिंदु P से, O केन्द्र वाले वृत्त पर स्पर्श रेखाएँ PA तथा PB खींची गई हैं। सिद्ध कीजिए कि ∠APB = 2∠OAB है।
questions.text_english: (a) Two tangents PA and PB are drawn to a circle with centre O from an external point P. Prove that ∠APB = 2∠OAB.

key_points: PA = PB so triangle PAB is isosceles

questions.solution: Let ∠APB = θ. Since PA = PB (tangents from external point), △PAB is isosceles, so ∠PAB = ∠PBA = (180° − θ)/2 = 90° − θ/2. Since OA ⊥ PA (radius ⊥ tangent), ∠OAP = 90°. Therefore ∠OAB = ∠OAP − ∠PAB = 90° − (90° − θ/2) = θ/2 = ∠APB/2. Hence ∠APB = 2∠OAB. Proved.
questions.solution_hindi: PA = PB से △PAB समद्विबाहु। ∠OAP = 90°। ∠OAB = 90° − ∠PAB = θ/2 = ∠APB/2, अतः ∠APB = 2∠OAB। सिद्ध।

questions.text: (ख) दी गई आकृति में, PA, O केन्द्र वाले वृत्त पर खींची गई ऐसी स्पर्श रेखा है कि OA = 10 cm, AB = 8 cm तथा AB ⊥ OP है। PB की लम्बाई ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.text_english: (b) In the given figure, PA is the tangent to the circle with centre O such that OA = 10 cm, AB = 8 cm and AB ⊥ OP. Find the length of PB.

key_points: OP = OA²/OB = 100/6... use power of point
PB = PA − AB then use Pythagoras

questions.image_description: A circle with centre O and radius OA = 10 cm. PA is a tangent from external point P. AB = 8 cm and AB is perpendicular to OP. B is a point on OA such that AB ⊥ OP.
questions.solution: OA = 10 cm, AB = 8 cm, AB ⊥ OP. In right triangle OAB: OB = √(OA² − AB²) = √(100 − 64) = √36 = 6 cm. Since OA is radius = 10 cm, and OB = 6 cm, so B divides OA. Since PA is tangent, OA ⊥ PA, so ∠OAP = 90°. In right triangle OAP: PA² = OP² − OA². Also since AB ⊥ OP at B, triangles OAB and OAP share angle O, so OA/OP = OB/OA (since △OAB ~ △OAP), giving OP = OA²/OB = 100/6 = 50/3. PA = √(OP² − OA²) = √(2500/9 − 100) = √(1600/9) = 40/3. Now PB: in right △PBA, PB² = PA² − AB²? No. PB = OP − OB = 50/3 − 6 = 32/3 cm.
questions.solution_hindi: OB = 6 cm, OP = OA²/OB = 50/3 cm, PB = OP − OB = 50/3 − 6 = 32/3 cm।

questions.text: सिद्ध कीजिए कि √3 एक अपरिमेय संख्या है।
questions.text_english: Prove that √3 is an irrational number.

key_points: Assume √3 is rational: √3 = p/q where p, q are coprime integers
3q² = p², so 3 divides p, let p = 3m
Then 3q² = 9m², q² = 3m², so 3 divides q — contradiction

questions.solution: Assume, for contradiction, that √3 is rational. Then √3 = p/q where p and q are integers with no common factor (i.e., HCF(p, q) = 1) and q ≠ 0. Squaring both sides: 3 = p²/q², so p² = 3q². This means 3 divides p². Since 3 is prime, 3 divides p. Let p = 3m for some integer m. Substituting: (3m)² = 3q², so 9m² = 3q², giving q² = 3m². This means 3 divides q². Since 3 is prime, 3 divides q. Now both p and q are divisible by 3, which contradicts our assumption that HCF(p, q) = 1. Hence our assumption is wrong, and √3 is irrational.
questions.solution_hindi: मान लो √3 = p/q (HCF = 1)। p² = 3q² से 3 | p, p = 3m। q² = 3m² से 3 | q। अतः HCF(p,q) ≥ 3, विरोधाभास। इसलिए √3 अपरिमेय है।

questions.text: समतल भूमि पर एक मीनार ऊर्ध्वाधर खड़ी है और ऊपर एक ध्वज को लगाया गया है। मीनार से 30 m की दूरी पर भूमि पर स्थित एक बिंदु से ध्वजदंड के शिखर तथा पाद पर क्रमश: 60° तथा 30° का उन्नयन कोण बनाती हुई तारें बाँधी गई हैं। मीनार की ऊँचाई तथा बाँधी गई तारों की लम्बाइयाँ ज्ञात कीजिए। (√3 = 1·73 लीजिए)
questions.text_english: A vertical tower stands on a horizontal plane and is surmounted by a vertical flagstaff. From a point on the ground 30 m away from the tower, wires are attached to the top and bottom of the flagstaff making angles of elevation 60° and 30° respectively. Find the height of the tower and lengths of the wires attached. (Take √3 = 1·73)

key_points: Wire to bottom of flagstaff = 30/cos30° = 20√3 m
Wire to top of flagstaff = 30/cos60° = 60 m

questions.solution: Let the height of the tower (bottom of flagstaff) be h metres and the height of the flagstaff be f metres. The observation point is 30 m from the base of the tower. Angle of elevation to bottom of flagstaff (top of tower) = 30°: tan 30° = h/30, so h = 30 × (1/√3) = 30/√3 = 10√3 = 10 × 1·73 = 17·3 m. Angle of elevation to top of flagstaff = 60°: tan 60° = (h + f)/30, so h + f = 30√3. Therefore f = 30√3 − 10√3 = 20√3 = 20 × 1·73 = 34·6 m. Wire to bottom of flagstaff (wire 1): length = 30/cos 30° = 30/(√3/2) = 60/√3 = 20√3 = 34·6 m. Wire to top of flagstaff (wire 2): length = 30/cos 60° = 30/(1/2) = 60 m. Hence height of tower = 17·3 m, wire 1 = 34·6 m, wire 2 = 60 m.
questions.topic: Heights and distances with flagstaff on tower

questions.text_english:
(a) The median of the following data is 137. Find the values of x and y, given that total of frequencies is 68.
Class: 65–85, 85–105, 105–125, 125–145, 145–165, 165–185, 185–205
Frequency: 4, 5, x, 20, 14, y, 4
questions.image_description: A frequency distribution table with class intervals 65-85, 85-105, 105-125, 125-145, 145-165, 165-185, 185-205 and frequencies 4, 5, x, 20, 14, y, 4 respectively.
questions.solution: Total frequency: 4 + 5 + x + 20 + 14 + y + 4 = 68, so x + y = 21. Cumulative frequencies: CF up to 85 = 4, up to 105 = 9, up to 125 = 9 + x, up to 145 = 29 + x. Median = 137 lies in class 125–145. Using median formula: Median = L + [(N/2 − CF)/f] × h, where L = 125, N/2 = 34, CF = 9 + x, f = 20, h = 20. So 137 = 125 + [(34 − 9 − x)/20] × 20 = 125 + (25 − x). Thus 137 − 125 = 25 − x, 12 = 25 − x, x = 13. Then y = 21 − 13 = 8. Therefore x = 13 and y = 8.

questions.text: बिंदु X, △ABC की माध्यिका AD पर स्थित ऐसा बिंदु है कि AX : XD = 2 : 3 है। BX को बढ़ाने पर यह भुजा AC को बिंदु Y पर प्रतिच्छेद करती है। सिद्ध कीजिए कि BX = 4 XY है।
questions.text_english: In △ABC, AD is a median. X is a point on AD such that AX : XD = 2 : 3. BX is extended so that it intersects AC at Y. Prove that BX = 4 XY.

key_points: Draw DM ∥ BY to meet AC at M
Use midpoint theorem in △DCM and ratio properties

questions.image_description: Triangle ABC with median AD where D is the midpoint of BC. X is a point on AD such that AX:XD = 2:3. BX extended meets AC at Y. The figure shows points A at top, B at bottom left, D at bottom middle, C at bottom right, X inside the triangle on AD, and Y on AC.
questions.solution: Draw DM ∥ BXY, meeting AC at M. Since D is the midpoint of BC (AD is median), and DM ∥ BY, by midpoint theorem in △BCY (considering the line through D parallel to BY), M is the midpoint of CY. Wait — let us use coordinates. Let A = (0, 0), D = (d, 0) (on median), B arbitrary. AX:XD = 2:3, so X divides AD in ratio 2:3. In △ADY and △XDM approach: Since DM ∥ BY in △ABX extended, and D is midpoint of BC, using BPT in △AXY with line through D: DM ∥ XY implies DM/XY = AD/(AX) — but let us use vectors. Let A = origin, B = b, C = c, D = (b+c)/2 (midpoint). X = A + (2/5)(D−A) = (2/5)D = (b+c)/5. Y is on AC: Y = λc for some λ. B, X, Y collinear: Y − B = t(X − B) for some t. λc − b = t((b+c)/5 − b) = t(b(1/5−1) + c/5) = t(−4b/5 + c/5). Comparing: coefficient of b: −1 = t(−4/5), t = 5/4. Coefficient of c: λ = t(1/5) = (5/4)(1/5) = 1/4. So Y = c/4. XY = |Y−X| = |c/4 − (b+c)/5| = |5c/20 − 4(b+c)/20| = |(5c − 4b − 4c)/20| = |(c − 4b)/20|. BX = |X−B| = |(b+c)/5 − b| = |(b+c−5b)/5| = |(c−4b)/5|. So BX/XY = |(c−4b)/5| / |(c−4b)/20| = 4. Hence BX = 4XY. Proved.

2x + 3y = 5, −3x + y = −2
questions.text_english:
(a) Solve the following system of equations graphically:
2x + 3y = 5, −3x + y = −2
questions.solution: For 2x + 3y = 5: when x = 0, y = 5/3; when x = 1, y = 1; when x = 4, y = −1. For −3x + y = −2: when x = 0, y = −2; when x = 1, y = 1; when x = 2, y = 4. Plotting these lines on a graph and extending them, both lines intersect at the point (1, 1). Verification: 2(1) + 3(1) = 5 ✓ and −3(1) + 1 = −2 ✓. Therefore the solution is x = 1 and y = 1.

questions.text: (ख) दो अंकों की एक संख्या के अंकों का योगफल 11 है। संख्या के अंकों को पलटने पर प्राप्त संख्या दी गई संख्या से 9 अधिक हो जाती है। संख्या ज्ञात करने के लिए: (i) उपर्युक्त परिस्थिति को रैखिक समीकरणों के रूप में लिखिए। (ii) दर्शाइए कि इन समीकरणों का अद्वितीय हल है। (iii) समीकरणों को हल करके दी गई दो अंकों की संख्या ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.text_english: (b) The sum of the digits of a 2-digit number is 11. The number obtained by interchanging its digits exceeds the given number by 9. To know the number: (i) form the linear equations representing the above situation. (ii) verify that the equations have a unique solution. (iii) solve the equations to get the given 2-digit number.

sub_questions.text: उपर्युक्त परिस्थिति को रैखिक समीकरणों के रूप में लिखिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Form the linear equations representing the above situation.
sub_questions.solution: Let the tens digit be x and units digit be y. The original number is 10x + y. Sum of digits: x + y = 11. The reversed number is 10y + x. Given: (10y + x) − (10x + y) = 9, so 9y − 9x = 9, giving y − x = 1. The two equations are: x + y = 11 and y − x = 1.

sub_questions.text: दर्शाइए कि इन समीकरणों का अद्वितीय हल है।
sub_questions.text_english: Verify that the equations have a unique solution.
sub_questions.solution: For the equations x + y = 11 (a₁=1, b₁=1, c₁=11) and −x + y = 1 (a₂=−1, b₂=1, c₂=1): checking a₁/a₂ = 1/(−1) = −1 and b₁/b₂ = 1/1 = 1. Since a₁/a₂ ≠ b₁/b₂, the equations have a unique solution.

sub_questions.text: समीकरणों को हल करके दी गई दो अंकों की संख्या ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Solve the equations to get the given 2-digit number.
sub_questions.solution: Adding x + y = 11 and −x + y = 1: 2y = 12, y = 6. Then x = 11 − 6 = 5. The original number = 10x + y = 10(5) + 6 = 56. Verification: digit sum = 5+6 = 11 ✓. Reversed number = 65 = 56 + 9 ✓. The required two-digit number is 56.

questions.solution: (i) Let tens digit = x, units digit = y. Equations: x + y = 11 and y − x = 1. (ii) a₁/a₂ = −1 ≠ b₁/b₂ = 1, so unique solution exists. (iii) Adding: 2y = 12, y = 6, x = 5. Number = 56.
questions.solution_hindi: (i) x+y=11 और y−x=1। (ii) अद्वितीय हल (a₁/a₂ ≠ b₁/b₂)। (iii) x=5, y=6, संख्या = 56।

questions.text: कुछ दोस्त ताश की दो एकसमान गड्डियों को लेकर उनसे ताश खेलना चाहते थे। ताश के पत्तों को फेंटते समय तीन पत्ते नीचे गिर गए। उन्होंने शेष पत्तों को अच्छी प्रकार फेंटकर यादृच्छया एक पत्ता निकाला। यह मानते हुए कि गिरे हुए तीन पत्तों में एक पान की बेगम, एक हुकुम का दस तथा एक चिड़ी का इक्का है, निम्नलिखित प्रश्नों के उत्तर दीजिए:
questions.text_english: A group of friends wanted to play cards with two identical packs together. While shuffling the cards, three cards are dropped. Rest of the cards are shuffled and one card is drawn at random. Assuming that the dropped cards were a queen of hearts, a ten of spades and an ace of clubs, answer the following questions:

sub_questions.text: इसकी क्या प्रायिकता है कि निकाला गया पत्ता एक फेस कार्ड (face card) है?
sub_questions.text_english: Find the probability that the drawn card is a face card.

key_points: Face cards in two decks = 2 × 12 = 24, one face card dropped (queen of hearts) = 23

sub_questions.solution: Two identical packs have 2 × 52 = 104 cards. After removing 3 dropped cards, remaining = 101 cards. Face cards (Jack, Queen, King of each suit) in two decks = 2 × 12 = 24. One queen of hearts dropped, so face cards remaining = 23. P(face card) = 23/101.

sub_questions.text: प्रायिकता ज्ञात कीजिए कि निकाला गया पत्ता बेगम या बादशाह है।
sub_questions.text_english: Find the probability that the drawn card is either a king or a queen.

key_points: Kings in 2 decks = 8, Queens in 2 decks = 8, one queen dropped = 7

sub_questions.solution: In two decks: Kings = 2 × 4 = 8, Queens = 2 × 4 = 8. One queen (of hearts) dropped, so queens remaining = 7. P(king or queen) = (8 + 7)/101 = 15/101.

sub_questions.text: क्या आपको लगता है कि यदि कोई पत्ता नहीं गिरता, तो निकाले गए पत्ते के बेगम होने की प्रायिकता ज्यादा होती? तर्क सहित उत्तर दीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Do you think that the probability of getting a queen was higher if none of the cards were dropped? Justify your answer.

key_points: Yes, probability was higher when no cards dropped

sub_questions.solution: If no cards were dropped: P(queen) = 8/104 = 1/13 ≈ 0·0769. With 3 cards dropped (including one queen): P(queen) = 7/101 ≈ 0·0693. Since 1/13 > 7/101, yes, the probability of getting a queen was higher when no cards were dropped. This is because dropping a queen reduced the count of queens while also reducing total cards, but the proportional decrease in queens was larger.

sub_questions.text: प्रायिकता ज्ञात कीजिए कि निकाला गया पत्ता गुलाम है। इसकी तुलना उस स्थिति में निकाली गई प्रायिकता से कीजिए यदि कोई पत्ता नहीं गिरता। किस परिस्थिति में निकाले गए पत्ते के गुलाम होने की प्रायिकता अधिक है?
sub_questions.text_english: Find the probability that the drawn card is a jack. Compare it with the probability when none of the cards were dropped. In which case is the probability of getting a jack higher?

key_points: 8/101 > 8/104, so jack probability is higher when cards are dropped

sub_questions.solution: Jacks in two decks = 2 × 4 = 8. None of the dropped cards was a jack, so jacks remaining = 8. P(jack after drop) = 8/101. If no cards dropped: P(jack) = 8/104 = 1/13. Comparing: 8/101 ≈ 0·0792 and 8/104 ≈ 0·0769. Since 8/101 > 8/104, the probability of getting a jack is higher when the three cards were dropped (because total cards decreased but the jack count remained the same).

questions.text:
मेज पर रखने के लिए 'लीफी बॉल फाउन्टेन' का एक मॉडल बनाया गया। पानी सहजता से गेंद की सतह से बहता हुआ एक सुसज्जित बेलनाकार टंकी में जाता है जहाँ से पुनः वापस आता है।
गोलाकार गेंद का व्यास 21 cm है।
बेलनाकार टंकी – बाह्य व्यास 50 cm है तथा आंतरिक व्यास 40 cm है।
ठोस आधार की ऊँचाई 14 cm है।
भरे हुए पानी की ऊँचाई 7 cm है।
questions.text_english:
A model of Leafy Ball Fountain is made to be kept on the tabletop. Water gently cascades down the ball into a decorative cylindrical pool where it is recycled.
The diameter of spherical ball is 21 cm.
Cylindrical pool – Outer diameter is 50 cm and inner diameter is 40 cm.
Height of solid base is 14 cm.
Height of water filled is 7 cm.

sub_questions.text: फव्वारे की कुल ऊँचाई ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Determine the total height of the fountain.

key_points: Total height = height of base + diameter of ball

sub_questions.solution: The total height of the fountain = height of solid base + diameter of spherical ball = 14 + 21 = 35 cm.

sub_questions.text_english: Find the volume of the ball.

sub_questions.text: यदि गेंद का एक-तिहाई हिस्सा पानी में डूबा हो, तो टंकी में पानी का आयतन ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: If one-third of the ball is submerged in the water, find the volume of the water filled in the pool.

key_points: Volume of water in pool = Volume of cylindrical water − Volume of submerged ball

sub_questions.solution: Inner radius of pool = 40/2 = 20 cm. Volume of water in cylindrical pool = π × (inner radius)² × height of water. But the pool is an annular cylinder (hollow). Inner radius = 20 cm. Volume of water (cylindrical region up to height 7 cm with inner radius 20 cm) = π × 20² × 7 = 2800π cm³. Volume of ball submerged = (1/3) × 4851 = 1617 cm³. Volume of water = 2800π − 1617 = 2800 × (22/7) − 1617 = 8800 − 1617 = 7183 cm³.

sub_questions.text: बेलनाकार भाग का बाह्य वक्र पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल तथा गेंद के पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल का योगफल ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Find the sum of the outer curved surface area of the cylindrical part and surface area of the ball.
sub_questions.solution: Outer radius of cylindrical pool = 50/2 = 25 cm. Height of solid base = 14 cm. Outer curved surface area of cylinder = 2πrh = 2 × (22/7) × 25 × 14 = 2 × 22 × 50 = 2200 cm². Surface area of spherical ball = 4πr² = 4 × (22/7) × (10·5)² = 4 × (22/7) × 110·25 = (4 × 22 × 110·25)/7 = 9702/7 = 1386 cm². Total = 2200 + 1386 = 3586 cm².

questions.text: रंगमंच के नाटक के दौरान, मंच की पृष्ठभूमि के लिए भवन मेहराब (arches) का प्रयोग किया गया। नीचे दिखाई गई एक मेहराब (arch) के वक्र को बहुपद p(x) = −x² + 2x + 8 के द्वारा निरूपित किया जा सकता है। यहाँ x मंच की सतह पर लम्बाई (फुट में) को दर्शाता है।
questions.text_english: During a theatre drama, a backdrop of building arches was used. The shape of the curve shown below can be represented by the polynomial p(x) = −x² + 2x + 8, where x is the length (in feet) on stage level.

sub_questions.text_english: Determine the height of the arch.

key_points: Height is maximum value of p(x)

sub_questions.solution: The height of the arch is the maximum value of p(x) = −x² + 2x + 8. At x = 1 (axis of symmetry, x = −b/2a = −2/(−2) = 1): p(1) = −(1)² + 2(1) + 8 = −1 + 2 + 8 = 9. The height of the arch is 9 feet. This is confirmed by point C(1, y) in the figure where y = 9.

sub_questions.text: बहुपद p(x) के शून्यक ज्ञात कीजिए। उपर्युक्त ग्राफ में कौन-से बिंदु शून्यक को दर्शाते हैं?
sub_questions.text_english: Find zeroes of the polynomial p(x). Which points on the graph represent the zeroes?

key_points: Points A(4,0) and B(−2,0) on graph

sub_questions.solution: Setting p(x) = 0: −x² + 2x + 8 = 0, so x² − 2x − 8 = 0. Factorising: (x − 4)(x + 2) = 0, giving x = 4 or x = −2. The zeroes are x = 4 and x = −2. On the graph, these correspond to points A(4, 0) and B(−2, 0) where the curve intersects the x-axis (stage level).

sub_questions.text: मंच की सतह पर मेहराब का विस्तार (span) ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Find the span of the arch on the stage floor.
sub_questions.solution: The span of the arch is the horizontal distance between the two zeroes of p(x). The zeroes are x = −2 and x = 4. Span = 4 − (−2) = 6 feet. Therefore the arch spans 6 feet on the stage floor.

sub_questions.text: उपर्युक्त वक्र तथा y-अक्ष के प्रतिच्छेदी बिंदु के निर्देशांक लिखिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Write the coordinates of the point of intersection of the above curve with the y-axis.
sub_questions.solution: The curve meets the y-axis where x = 0. Substituting x = 0 in p(x) = −x² + 2x + 8: p(0) = 0 + 0 + 8 = 8. Therefore the curve intersects the y-axis at the point (0, 8).
